'''Amira Paendrag''' was the first daughter of King [[Artur Paendrag Tanreall]] and Queen [[Amaline Paendrag Tagora]], born in {{Fy|942}} when her father was still the King of [[Shandalle]]. Amira had a twin brother, [[Modair Paendrag]], and a younger brother and sister, whose names are unknown.

==History==
After being devastated by his son, Modair's, death in {{Fy|959}}, Tanreall was even more devastated when his wife and his remaining children, including Amira, were assassinated. This loss plunged him into the [[Black Years]].
